posts.title: SaaS is Dead, But I'll See What I Can do
posts.description: Keep producing software. While big software may be dead and dying, small software is well and truly alive. Everyone I talk to seems to believe the sky is falling on big SaaS. That may be true, but I don't think software is dead. It seems to me there has never been a better time to make things. When we look past the techno-doomism, what I see is people building. posts.title: A Radical Framework for Thinking about AI in Tasks
posts.description: My new approach to tasks is always "can AI do this?" and following it by trying to have AI do it. posts.title: If You Don't Use AI At All, I Will Poke Fun at You
posts.description: We have a site for folks who refuse to Google: LMGTFY . Maybe we need one for ChatGPT. I've realized the amount of sheer stubbornness people have when it comes to simply ignoring the changing world with AI. I'm not speaking about the moon shot projects like fully autonomous robots or completely automated white collar jobs with AI Agents. I'm talking about basic utilization of a fantastic new tool.
